content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals for Data Engineers
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Creating and Managing Tables
    - Lesson 3: Basic CRUD Operations (Insert, Update, Delete)
    - Lesson 4: JOIN Operations: INNER, OUTER, LEFT, RIGHT
    - Lesson 5: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 6: Aggregate Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN)
    - Lesson 7: GROUP BY Clause and Having Clause
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Sorting and Ordering (DESC, ASC)
    - Lesson 9: Practical SQL Queries for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 10: Optimizing SQL Performance

   Track: Python Essentials for Data Engineers
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and its Data Science Libraries
    - Lesson 2: Basic Python Syntax (Variables, Loops, Functions)
    - Lesson 3: Advanced Python Concepts (List Comprehension, Generators, Decorators)
    - Lesson 4: Data Manipulation with Pandas (DataFrames, Series)
    - Lesson 5: Reading and Writing Files (CSV, Excel, SQL)
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Data Cleaning Techniques (Handling Missing Values, Outliers)
    - Lesson 7: Data Visualization with Matplotlib (Scatter Plots, Bar Charts, Line Charts)
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Interactive Dashboards with Plotly or Seaborn

   Track: Databases and ETL Processes for Data Engineers
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Database Management Systems (DBMS)
    - Lesson 2: Designing and Normalizing Databases
    - Lesson 3: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) Concepts
    - Lesson 4: ETL Tools and Techniques (Apache Beam, Airflow, SQL Server Integration Services)
    - Lesson 5: Optimizing ETL Performance for Big Data Systems
    - Lesson 6: Distributed Databases and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra)
    - Lesson 7: Real-time Streaming Data Processing (Apache Kafka, Apache Storm)
    - Lesson 8: Cloud-based Database Services (Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics)

   Track: Introduction to Big Data and Hadoop
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Big Data Concepts (Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity)
    - Lesson 2: Distributed File Systems (HDFS, S3)
    - Lesson 3: MapReduce Programming for Big Data Processing
    - Lesson 4: Hadoop Ecosystem Tools (Pig, Hive, Spark)
    - Lesson 5: Scala and Java for Apache Spark Development
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Analytics with Apache Spark (MLlib, GraphX)
    - Lesson 7: Real-time Big Data Streaming with Apache Flink
    - Lesson 8: Using Big Data Tools in the Cloud (Google Dataproc, Azure HDInsight, AWS EMR)

   Track: Cloud Services for Data Engineers
    - Lesson 1: Amazon Web Services (AWS) for Data Engineering
    - Lesson 2: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Data Engineering
    - Lesson 3: Microsoft Azure for Data Engineering
    - Lesson 4: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, CloudFormation or ARM Templates
    - Lesson 5: Containerization and Orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes
    - Lesson 6: Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) for Data Engineering
    - Lesson 7: Monitoring and Troubleshooting Cloud Resources
    - Lesson 8: Best Practices for Securing Cloud Resources

   Track: Data Quality Assurance and Governance
    - Lesson 1: Data Profiling and Validation Techniques
    - Lesson 2: Data Lineage and Impact Analysis
    - Lesson 3: Data Quality Metrics (Accuracy, Completeness, Consistency)
    - Lesson 4: Master Data Management and Data Catalogs
    - Lesson 5: Data Privacy and Protection (GDPR, HIPAA)
    - Lesson 6: Implementing Data Governance Policies and Procedures
    - Lesson 7: Enforcing Data Quality through Automation and Monitoring
    - Lesson 8: Data Discovery and Analysis for Continuous Improvement
